['Techem GmbH '].company_description: Techem GmbH operates in the metering industry and offers products and services for energy management, carbon dioxide reduction in apartments and commercial real estate. The company provides equipment to measure consumption of water and electricity and monitor heating and cooling.

['SGL Carbon SE '].company_description: SGL Carbon SE is a European company based in Germany and is one of the world's leading manufacturers of products from carbon. It has 29 production sites around the globe and a service network in over 100 countries. The company's headquarters is in Wiesbaden, Germany. In 2022, the company generated sales revenue of €1,135.9 million and employed 4,760 staff worldwide.
